facts.business: One MobiKwik Systems Limited operates a digital payments platform with 189.6 million registered users and 4.92 million merchant partners, offering UPI payments, payment gateway services (Zaakpay), and financial services including ZIP EMI personal loans through lending partners.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Net payments margin guidance band of 12 to 15 basis points

key_risks: Regulatory expectations for lending partners evolved across the industry
Dependence on banking and NBFC partners for lending products
Transition from distribution economics to ownership economics with NBFC license
